status: interface and artifact definition; no integrated RTL performance yet
scope: One cold 99x64 by 64x256 linear task, frozen x8_w8_y8_h0, original official fabric and shared SRAM port
format: Rice32 with existing frozen X k2/delta64, W k5/raw transform, Y k3/delta16; no numerical changes

input_packet.word2_to9: W group0..7 encoded valid bit counts
input_packet.word10_to137: 256 signed16 biases, lower channel in low half
input_packet.word138_to201: 256 unsigned8 shifts, lower channel in low byte; accepted values0..47
input_packet.word202_onward: X encoded words then W group0..7 encoded words, each stream independently zero-padded to32bits
input_packet.X: 99x64 row-major, only6336 actual bytes; adapter generates padded row99 locally
input_packet.W_group: 64x32 K-row-major for columns32g..32g+31; bounded row-pair adapter transforms into task8 private writes

output_packet.word0: After header/range/disjointness validation, write0 and wait for its real ACK before decoding X. Write0x31593851 (little-endian ASCII Q8Y1) last, only after all sixteen payloads and length writes are acknowledged. Reusing an output address therefore invalidates the prior successful marker. Invalid descriptors leave output unchanged; callers must use this task completion/error status, never a preexisting marker alone.
output_packet.word1_to16: Y tile0..15 encoded valid bit counts
output_packet.payload: Each tile99x16 row-major, independently encoded and padded. Only ceil(valid_bits/32) words written; unused slot words stay untouched.
output_packet.capacity_proof: 1584*8 + ceil(1584/32) =12722 worst-case bits, ceil(/32)=398 words. Raw escape prevents larger valid streams.
output_packet.timing_end: The final originating bus ACK of word0 completion marker; never core done or encoder last alone

dataflow: E203 submits source/output pointers and START; hardware checks alignment, full input/output bounds, format, lengths and disjoint ranges.
BEGIN invalidates private X/R/W/C epochs; shared read cache explicitly clears before first task header request.
Read input header through the original bus, then decode X and reorder into1600 real private X words; no source-to-live SRAM copy.
For each of eight groups read/decode/reorder512 W words, then read16 bias words and8 shift words from input metadata into task core.
Encode each of sixteen Y tiles as its words emerge; stream accepted compressed words to that tile's fixed output slot and store its actual valid-bit count.
Transport must support finite write-prefix completion because compressed output word count is not known until encoder last; integration cannot guess a descriptor count or write unused slot padding.

All offered/accepted shared-bus commands drain on errors. Internal codec/core resets may discard private state only after both ends of their stream are explicitly reset and shared responses are safely drained.
open_implementation_items: Frozen icb_stream_prefix implements bounded last-terminated write descriptors. Output writes include18 header operations (one invalidation,16 lengths,one final marker); the earlier17-header analytical budget excludes the new invalidation transaction and is lower by one bus write plus its scheduling overhead.
Complete-task core first revision is sequential and fails the cycle target; compute/store overlap and W-bank scheduling must be implemented and measured.
External official loader start event remains unresolved; publish preloaded-source engineering window and strict initial-write window separately.
Every extra cache, FIFO, macro, register, speculative read and codec logic counts in area/whole-SoC power;150MHz requires actual STA.
acceptance: Same candidate >10450 tasks/s, incremental area<=0.5mm2, whole-SoC energy<=6.3uJ, correct complete-task results and official timing/precision scope; all unproven
